note: Launch Day (src/learning/launch.ts, src/ui/launch/LaunchDay.tsx): build a stack, then survive a launch's traffic. The numbers are game-sized, but every behaviour is a real one, from the page in `source` (wording ours).

cloudfront.name: CloudFront
cloudfront.rule: Copies of your pages wait at edge locations near people, so most reads never reach your servers.

shield.name: Shield & WAF
shield.rule: A rate-based rule blocks clients that send too many requests, so a bot flood doesn't use up your servers.

apigateway.name: API Gateway
apigateway.rule: Throttling turns away requests above a steady rate, protecting what's behind it from being overwhelmed.

ec2-1az.name: EC2, one AZ
ec2-1az.rule: Two servers in one Availability Zone: a fixed amount of work at a time, and nothing left if that zone goes dark.

ec2-2az.name: EC2, two AZs
ec2-2az.rule: One server in each of two Availability Zones: if a zone goes dark, the other keeps serving.

lambda.name: Lambda
lambda.rule: Scales out on its own, adding up to 1,000 execution environments every 10 seconds, and runs across zones for you.

sqs.name: SQS queue
sqs.rule: Writes wait in the queue when workers are busy, instead of failing, and are worked through when there's room.

elasticache.name: ElastiCache
elasticache.rule: Repeat reads come from memory in microseconds, taking load off the database.

rds-1az.name: RDS, one AZ
rds-1az.rule: A fixed amount of work at a time, and it stops if its zone goes dark.

rds-multiaz.name: RDS Multi-AZ
rds-multiaz.rule: A standby in another zone takes over if the first fails; failover typically takes 60 to 120 seconds.

dynamodb.name: DynamoDB on-demand
dynamodb.rule: On-demand instantly accommodates up to double the previous peak, with no capacity to plan.

days.name: Launch day
days.simple: Your app goes live. Expect a rush when the news drops.

days.name: Going viral
days.simple: Someone famous shares it, and halfway through, one Availability Zone goes dark.

days.name: Under attack
days.simple: A bot flood hits your front door while real customers keep coming.
